CAREER OPPORTUNITIES

Open Positions in Tampa, FL

We are looking for motivated insurance professionals to join our growing agency.

COMMERCIAL LINES • FULL-TIME

Commercial Lines Account Manager

Manage renewals, endorsements, certificate of insurance (COI) issuance, and policyholder service for small to mid-sized business clients. Requires active Florida 2-20 or 4-40 license.

Apply for this position →

PERSONAL LINES • FULL-TIME

Personal Lines Account Specialist

Help Florida homeowners and drivers quote, bind, and optimize their property, flood, auto, and umbrella policies across multiple carrier portals. Florida 2-20 or 4-40 required.

Apply for this position →

CLIENT SERVICES • FULL-TIME

Client Care & Support Specialist

Serve as first point of contact for policy inquiries, billing coordination with mortgage escrow companies, document requests, and claims routing in our Tampa office.

Apply for this position →

Continuing Education

We sponsor CE courses, professional designations (CIC, CISR, CPCU), and advanced licensing.

Competitive Benefits

Comprehensive group health coverage, retirement matching, and generous paid time off.

Prime Downtown Office

Work in the heart of downtown Tampa at 100 N Tampa St, Suite 2500.

Client-First Culture

A professional environment focused on genuine advisory service rather than high-pressure quotas.

HOW TO APPLY

Ready to Join Surebound?

To apply for any open role, send your resume and a brief introduction covering your Florida insurance experience to careers@sureboundinsurance.com. Include the position title in the subject line. We look forward to hearing from you.
